sn45.39:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the holy life and the fruits of the holy life.
sn45.39:1.4: “And what, bhikkhus, is the holy life?
sn45.39:1.5: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.39:1.7: This is called the holy life.
sn45.39:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, are the fruits of the holy life?
sn45.39:1.9: The fruit of stream-entry, the fruit of once-returning, the fruit of nonreturning, the fruit of arahantship.
sn45.39:1.10: These are called the fruits of the holy life.”
